entities.summary: Jarl Frithiof Lundqvist was a Finnish lieutenant general. Lundqvist was the Commander of the Finnish Air Force from 8 September 1932 to 29 June 1945. After World War II, he was the Chief of Defence of the Finnish Defence Forces between 1945 and 1946.
